thread:
zara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need tight owners + single-line due dates for the rollout safety work (auto-rollback, cohort limits, metric gates). Post one-line commitments and I'll export to the action tracker.

hussein: I'll own auto-rollback flow + tests. Plan: add an idempotent rollback step, integrate with release-controller, add e2e that simulates failure, then gradual rollout. Ticket INF-9911, title: owner: hussein | due: 2025-04-14.

lina: I'll take cohort limits & flag defaults. Proposal: default initial cohort 0.1% for 1h, ramp to 1% for 6h, then 5% over 48h; hard max 12% unless security/product override. Ticket INF-9912, title: owner: lina | due: 2025-03-31.

sre-oncall: I'll wire the synthetic canary and add a visible metric in the console for canary health (canary_success_rate, canary_latency_p95). Ticket INF-9913, title: owner: sre-oncall | due: 2025-03-28.

release-bot: ticket-update: INF-9911 assigned -> hussein (due 2025-04-14); INF-9912 assigned -> lina (due 2025-03-31); INF-9913 assigned -> sre-oncall (due 2025-03-28).

ops-pm: From PM ops: please include a one-line runbook entry in each ticket: "manual abort owner: <name> | console path: Releases > Abort". Also need a short customer blurb template for rollbacks.

hussein: Will add runbook line to INF-9911 and a short PR checklist. Rollback behavior: first pause on single-signal breach, abort only when two independent signals (metric gate + canary fail) cross thresholds within 10m. I'll document thresholds.

lina: For migration: existing flags should keep current exposure until updated; include an opt-in script for orgs that want the new conservative defaults. I'll add a migration note in INF-9912.

sre-oncall: Question for the group — should the synthetic canary auto-fail a rollout or only generate an alert/pause? My preference: alert+auto-pause for 3 consecutive windows, auto-abort if metric-gates also degrade. Avoid single-signal aborts.

hussein: Agree with pause-first. Auto-abort after corroboration. Also adding a 5-minute cooldown window so noisy spikes don't trigger cascading rollbacks.

ops-pm: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb: 1) what a rollback means, 2) expected user impact, 3) where to check status. Will attach to INF-9914 (doc ticket) and aim for 2025-04-02.

release-bot: note: INF-9914 created for customer comms, owner: ops-pm | due: 2025-04-02.

zara: Consolidated checklist below — update tickets if anything is off. I'll import to the postmortem tracker once confirmed.

- Auto-rollback flow \u0000 owner: hussein \u0000 ticket: INF-9911 \u0000 due: 2025-04-14
- Flag cohort defaults + migration \u0000 owner: lina \u0000 ticket: INF-9912 \u0000 due: 2025-03-31
- Synthetic canary + console metrics \u0000 owner: sre-oncall \u0000 ticket: INF-9913 \u0000 due: 2025-03-28
- Customer blurb + docs \u0000 owner: ops-pm \u0000 ticket: INF-9914 \u0000 due: 2025-04-02

hussein: I'll mark INF-9911 WIP and post an initial design PR by EOD Monday.

lina: UI mock + migration script outline will be in INF-9912 today.

sre-oncall: Synthetic job PR scheduled for tomorrow morning.

zara: Let's reconvene in 72h for a quick progress check. If anyone gets blocked, DM me and we'll reassign. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
